name: Lilly Satou
source:
Having befriended Hisao shortly after his arrival at Yamaku, Lilly has watched (so to speak) him and her best friend Hanako slowly grow closer to one another, but a request from her estranged family in Scotland forced her to temporarily leave the academy while her two friends were still in the process of figuring out their relationship.

Receiving the news that her two friends are now a committed couple has left her both relieved and overjoyed, but as she prepares to fly back to her homeland of Japan, she's forced to bring another, more personal, burden along with her.
